name: com.tencent.android.tpush.XGVipPushKAProvider
description: When Android creates this Tencent TPNS keep-alive provider, it asks TPNS to start its push service if the app has opted into the TPNS channel.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes this startup path for the TPNS push service, so push delivery or background recovery may stop working.
